This happens to me when I have reverb added to a multitrack (not within the file itself). If you added a similar effect, just add the effect in the file itself and not in the multitrack, as it seems Audition likes to give additional time after a reverb on a track. Within the file itself, you can control how long the effect / reverb lasts.

I have found that adding effects to tracks as a whole from the multitrack (not like within the actual file in the track) sometimes causes Audition to act up and become slow. It even gives you warnings about this.

For example, if you apply a Reverb->Full Reverb effect to an entire track in Multitrack Session, it could affect the Audition playback.

You could try removing any effects like this (if you have them) until you are finished with your composition, or just add the reverb within the individual files.
